about: All 55 PS5 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned). Every trophy is offline and single-player — there are no online trophies. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official list published 2026-11-18; guide text, kinds, stages and missable flags are this guide's own work, with the source of any specific claim named on the trophy itself. Reported by GTABase and TechWiser: using cheats disables trophies and saving, so keep cheats off for a trophy run.
sources: Official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags) via Exophase & PSNProfiles, cross-checked against the list as republished by PowerPyx, GTABase, Beebom and TechWiser
Roadmap stage order follows PowerPyx-style platinum routes: story first, then strands, activities, collectibles, free-roam feats, 100% last
Missable reporting: PowerPyx & GTABase flag Positive Mental Attitude as possibly missable; TechWiser reports the five stranger chains have windows tied to story progress

stages.name: Story campaign
stages.tip: Play the campaign start to finish. All 12 story trophies are hidden until earned, and the one-off moments flagged in this stage (a certain airport departure, your story choices) are cheapest to grab as they pass. Cheats off.

stages.name: Strangers & side strands
stages.tip: Clear the stranger chains — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, plus Cal and Bret. TechWiser reports these chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave them all for after the finale.

stages.name: Activities & challenges
stages.tip: Ranges, races, stunts, drones, arcade, bowling: the skill-based grind. Medals and wins are saved individually, so chip away at them between other stages.

stages.name: Collectibles & exploration
stages.tip: Cards, meditation spots, WAiNK locations, vehicles and the full map of Leonida. Route them region by region and tick them off in the tracker as you go.

stages.name: Crime, money & free-roam feats
stages.tip: Robberies, partner feats, laundering and spending. Free roam only, so failed attempts cost nothing — this is also where the garage purchases live.

stages.name: 100% & the platinum
stages.tip: The gold for 100% completion, then the platinum itself. Use the in-game completion menu to hunt the last missing percent.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task — just work the roadmap stages in order and save the 100% grind for last. If everything else shows as earned and this has not popped, restart the game once; a delayed platinum pop is a display lag, not a lost trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is hidden until earned and cannot be missed on any playthrough — complete the mission and it pops at the results screen. Skipping cutscenes is safe; only the completion itself matters.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Pure progression: follow the main markers with either protagonist and the trophy unlocks as the chapter wraps. No side content, collectibles or medals are needed for this one.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story progression only — keep clearing the main missions and it unlocks at the chapter's end. And yes, the asterisks are really how the name is spelled on PSN; it is not a display bug in this guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story progression only; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. The gaps between chapters are a good time to start the meditation spots and WAiNK locations in whatever region you are standing in, so the collectible stage never becomes one long sweep.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story progression only — finish the chapter's missions and it unlocks automatically. By this point most of Leonida is open, which makes it the natural moment to begin the activity and collectible cleanup in earnest.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; some outlets word the requirement as completing Chapter 5
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the final story mission (some outlets describe the same step as completing Chapter 5). Finish the campaign and it pops whatever choices you made along the way. Everything else on the list can be cleaned up in free roam afterwards, so push through the finale first.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It sits inside the main campaign, so it unlocks simply by playing through the story in order. Like all 12 story trophies, it stays hidden on your PSN list until the moment it is earned.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, one of the campaign's set-piece missions. Story progression only — finish the heist and the trophy is yours. If the mission offers approach choices, any of them counts; pick the one that suits your loadout.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Part of the main campaign and unmissable on a story playthrough — there is nothing to prepare and nothing optional attached to it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story progression only: play the mission through to its end and the trophy unlocks. If you are chasing a clean first run, save before starting it — but a messy completion still counts.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Story progression only. While you are at the airport, keep 'Catch Me If You Can' in mind: its unscheduled-departure moment is easiest to arrange with the aircraft this mission puts in reach.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story progression only — finish the operation and the trophy pops at the end of it. Together with the chapter trophies this completes the named-mission set.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; guide sites rate it the hardest trophy on the list
trophies.guide: Reach 100% game completion — the gold that guide sites rate as the hardest on the list, purely for the hours it takes. Story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges all feed the percentage, and the in-game completion menu tells you exactly which category is short. Do it last: finish stages 1–5, then hunt the missing percent.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the jumps and stunt moves scattered across Leonida. The counter is cumulative, so every stunt you land during the story is already banked. For the bulk of them, wait until the map is fully open and clear the stunt spots region by region; a fast bike or a light sports car makes most ramps forgiving.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; activity-type count (9) per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win, finish or even do well — starting each type a single time registers it. A quick tour after the story unlocks this in minutes: use the map's activity filter and visit one of everything you have not touched.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; challenge count (42) per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range is a pattern problem: run it once to learn where targets appear, then repeat until accuracy and time both hit gold. Medals save individually, so grind one range at a time — and leave this until after the story, when you have handled every weapon class the ranges throw at you.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; location count (14) per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — one win per location is enough; you do not need to clear every event at a spot. Fly a sighting lap first to learn the gates, then run it clean: with drones, a smooth line beats raw speed because every gate strike costs more time than a cautious corner.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct event counts once, so keep moving around the map instead of replaying a favourite, and tick each win off here. Any vehicle class counts, and wins from your story playthrough are already in the total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge. Find Cal, take the challenge, and learn the reeling rhythm before you worry about his score — steady tension beats frantic winding. Losing costs nothing: you can challenge him again straight away, and only the win counts.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to the end — the requirement is completion, not a high score. One of the quickest trophies on the list; grab it whenever you pass an arcade during cleanup.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; story-progress windows for stranger chains reported by TechWiser
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Work Andy's chain as its markers appear and the trophy pops at the end of the last job. Caution: TechWiser reports the stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so clear Andy's missions as they open instead of parking the whole set until after the finale.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; story-progress windows for stranger chains reported by TechWiser
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand — the name is a Jaws joke, the requirement is not. Follow Kenton's chain to its last job. As with all five stranger finales, TechWiser reports windows tied to story progress, so finish the chain reasonably soon after it opens rather than saving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; story-progress windows for stranger chains reported by TechWiser
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Keep clearing Billy's markers as they appear and finish the last job in the chain. TechWiser reports these chains run on story-progress windows, so treat a fresh Billy marker as a prompt to go now, not later.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Every finished strand counts: the five named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them, so you need three more strands beyond those. Track the strand count in the completion menu and mop up any remaining strangers during stage 2 — remembering TechWiser's warning that chains can sit on story-progress windows.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; story-progress windows for stranger chains reported by TechWiser
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Play Randy's chain through to its conclusion and the trophy unlocks after the final job. If Randy's marker vanishes for a while, progress the story a little and check back — but per TechWiser's reporting on story-progress windows, do not leave the chain hanging across multiple chapters.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; story-progress windows for stranger chains reported by TechWiser
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Finish Tyrone's chain of jobs and the trophy is yours. Same caution as the other four finales: TechWiser reports windows tied to story progress, so clear the chain while it is current.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; flagged as possibly missable by PowerPyx & GTABase; spot count (18) per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — scenic viewpoints where you stop and use the meditate prompt. This is the one trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable, so do not leave the whole set for the very end: clear each region's spots while you are there for other reasons, and tick them off here as you go. Routed region by region alongside the WAiNK locations, the set is a pleasant drive rather than a grind.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Start Bret's strand, follow the tracking steps, and make the kill — the animal is a one-off spawn tied to his job. If you spook it, back off and return rather than chasing it across the county; a scoped rifle from a calm position makes the shot clean.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in themed sets, and only finished sets count — you do not need every card in the game, just three complete sets. Pick the three shortest sets, route them card by card, and tick each card off in the tracker so a set never sits at 90% while you wander.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Wherever the WAiNK prompt appears — viewpoints and landmarks all over the state — use it; each new location adds one to the counter. Weave it into everything else: most spots sit near meditation points, cards or stunt jumps, so a combined region route clears several lists at once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the short scored tasks dotted around the map and the activity menus. Any 50 count and the total is cumulative, so challenges you finished during the story are already banked. Mix quick ones (short races, range rounds, single stunts) and this falls out of the stage-3 cleanup almost on its own.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. Build four stars together in free roam, then break line of sight — tunnels, alleys, a vehicle swap and a change of clothes all shorten the search. Do it away from missions so a botched attempt costs nothing but a few minutes.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without your Wanted Level dropping in between. Plan the route first: three stores close together, a fast car outside each, and no hiding until the third till is empty. The chain breaks if the stars fully clear, so keep moving and keep the pressure on.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting into a vehicle model you have not used before adds it to the discovered list. Traffic variety changes by district, so cruise rich, poor, industrial and rural areas and steal everything unfamiliar you see parked. Pair it with 'On the Spot': every vehicle you register for the Scooter Bros app is also a discovery.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded fight — a gang operation or a busy story shootout — charge the focus meter first, then trigger it with at least five enemies in view. If you keep running one short, soften a group up with body shots first, then finish them all inside one focus window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable-note: one-off moment — easiest during the VCIA Takedown mission
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport never intended: steal an aircraft and take off outside any scripted sequence. The VCIA Takedown story mission puts you on the airfield with planes in reach, which is the natural moment; if you pass it by, return in free roam, get onto the tarmac and take a plane out. This guide classes it as a one-off moment: grab it when the chance is in front of you.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable-note: one-off feat — needs a Rhino encounter
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: The coy description is the clue: this is about Rhinos, the military tank. Expect to steal, survive or destroy one — the reliable way to meet one is to draw serious military attention (a high wanted level near military ground) and deal with the armour that responds. Bring explosives, keep a heavy vehicle nearby, and do it in free roam where a failed attempt is free. This guide will not pretend the exact trigger is confirmed; the Rhino encounter is what every reading of the description points at.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quietly, keep the staff controlled and get out before an alarm or a witness call brings the police down. If a detection indicator starts climbing, walk away and retry — once you know the layout, a clean run is short.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time — a vault only counts if you get away, so plan the exit before you crack it: fast car placed well, a route out of the district, somewhere to lie low. Work through five different vaults to be safe; if the in-game counter also advances on a repeat vault, you will simply finish sooner than planned.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape with the take. Armored trucks roam in traffic: when you spot one, follow it to a quiet stretch, block it, deal with the guards, grab the cash and lose the heat. Ramming it in a busy street works too, but a quiet road makes the escape half as hard.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; area count (52) per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Areas register as you enter them, and the ones you will miss are predictable: rural corners, small islands and districts no mission ever sends you to. Leave it until the map is open, then take one full road trip around the state and pair it with the meditation spots and WAiNK locations so no journey is wasted.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; gang count (9) per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida, and territory tells you whose is whose — rob one per gang, not nine of the same crew. Keep your own list in the tracker: the trophy only pops when all nine gangs have been hit, and the game will not remind you which one you skipped.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missable-note: one-off moment — a specific spot on Ocean Beach
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach strip, find a bar or cocktail spot facing the water, and order one — a quiet one-off moment rather than a challenge. It is available in free roam at any point, so fold it into your first Vice Beach exploration trip and forget about it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get into a car on the showroom floor and drive it straight out through the glass. Any showroom with a car inside works. You will leave with a wanted level and a smile — have an escape route in mind before you put your foot down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missable-note: one-off feat — one specific bowling alley
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — in plain terms, go to that specific alley and play a game of bowling there. Other alleys do not count; it has to be Kolt & Associates. Walk in, start a game and finish it; the 'follow-through' in the description is flavour, the requirement is bowling at that address.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable-note: one-off moment — exact trigger unconfirmed in the official list
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; no guide had pinned down the trigger when the list was published
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' points at a one-off moment involving your partner rather than a repeatable activity. Honest position: no published guide had pinned down the exact trigger when the official list appeared, so this guide will not invent steps. Practical advice: keep a manual save before the finale and before major partner story beats; if it has not popped by the credits, reload and vary what you do in the partner scenes. It is classed here as a one-off moment so you keep it in mind during the story, not in the cleanup.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable-note: one-off moments — story choices as they happen
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; the 500 count is how PSN tracks it, per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: the game tracks the choices you make as you play, and PSN counts them — the list tracks a running total up to 500. Engage with every choice prompt instead of letting it time out on a default, and the counter climbs steadily through the story and side content. Because choices are one-time moments, this guide classes it with the one-off trophies: you cannot farm them in a menu afterwards, so pay attention when the game asks.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable-note: one-off feat — fail once, then succeed at the same thing
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on your second attempt, straight after failing it. The cleanest setup is a quick repeatable challenge — deliberately fail a short race or a range round, then immediately retry the same one and win it. No luck involved, despite the name; it is a two-step recipe you can do on demand.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable-note: one-off moment — a rare strange event
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; no confirmed location was published with the official list
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida's entry in Rockstar's long tradition of weird, unexplained events. Strange events are rare and tend to favour remote spots at night; if something odd starts happening near you, stop, watch, and let it play out until the trophy pops. No confirmed location shipped with the official list, and this guide will not invent one: treat it as a happy accident to stay alert for during the exploration stage, especially after dark.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missable-note: one-off feat — a melee swing from a moving vehicle
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock a pedestrian down with a melee swing delivered from a moving vehicle. A motorcycle at walking pace in a crowded area is the forgiving setup — close pass, melee button, one pedestrian down. It takes a couple of tries to judge the range; each attempt costs seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; instead of sitting on them, run them through your laundering contacts and keep the robbery cycle going until the laundered total passes a quarter million. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every stage-5 robbery is progress — track the running total here.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothing, vehicle services, food, gear — everything counts as long as it is shop spending, and it all adds up across the whole game. Most players pass this without trying; if you are short late on, a Vice City shopping spree closes the gap in minutes.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles; garage count (8) per the republished list notes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages come up for sale as you progress and earn; buy every one that appears on the map. This is why the money stage exists: the robbery and laundering income from stage 5 is what pays for the last garages, so leave the expensive ones until your income trophies are done.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.source: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you get into a vehicle that is new to you, use the app registration option before you drive off; ten different vehicles and the trophy pops. Pair it with 'Whip It Good' — the same habit of jumping into everything unfamiliar finishes both lists together.
